extraction_notes: Pages 3-4 contain non-vote-intention questions (suitability for PM, who are the main contenders, government coalitions, satisfaction with Smotrich/Ben Gvir) which per spec are ignored. The main vote-intention table is on page 2 with clear seats and percentages. The footnote indicates the percentages shown are weighted (אחוז גולמי vs אופמציה noted but the main table is weighted). Initial sample was 13,486 individuals who were contacted; 550 actual respondents (המדגם ההתחלתי); response rate 4%; margin of error ±4.7% at 95% confidence.
